scenario: Branches + routing requested, but site count and internet are unstated.
prompt: We need to connect our branches and set up routing between them. Make it work.
expected_behaviour: ASK: how many branches and where is the main site? Also unclear whether each branch needs its own internet or internet only at the main site. The model must NOT invent a site count. Correct behaviour is a targeted clarification, not a guess and not a full refusal.
why_valuable: Deliberately missing the site count — the number one thing the expander cannot invent. Tests clarify-don't-invent.
